// diagnostic

E0615

`.{name}` only works inside a marker block that declares it.

What

`.{name}` only works inside a marker block that declares it.

Why

A leading-dot member statement resolves against the enclosing applied rule's vocabulary; out here there is no such block.

Fix

Move it inside a `#Test("…") { … }` block, or write an ordinary statement.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0615: tests/ui/scope_member_outside.stderr.
